title: Nested include! slice B, formatting only: rustfmt the fragment files of 28 top-level includes before they become modules
outcome: Slice B of w-05336c2d00a3 converts 28 fragments that 15 module files include at their top level into child modules, with scripts/include-to-mod.mjs. `cargo fmt` does not reach an included file; 19 of the 29 files the conversion will bring within its reach (the 28 fragments and one module file a fragment declares) are not what rustfmt prints, so the conversion would fail `cargo fmt --all -- --check`. This candidate formats those files with rustfmt alone and changes nothing else, so that the conversion that follows is only the tool's output. The units are listed in a note on this item.
acceptance: This item's contribution to the candidate commit changes only files under src that slice B's conversion brings within `cargo fmt`'s reach: the fragment files of the listed units and the module files those fragments declare; every other path the commit changes belongs to another item, whose contribution is recorded with it.

For every path of this item's contribution, `git show PARENT:path | rustfmt --edition 2024` prints exactly the candidate's content of that path, where PARENT is the candidate's parent commit; the rustfmt version is recorded with the check.

The set of test names printed by `cargo test --bin termal -- --list` is the same on the candidate as on the candidate without this item's contribution, on one host; for a candidate that holds only this item's contribution that is its parent.
No test reads or pins source text for this change.
